answer: Jury seats are assigned by network path, not by stake. A panel must draw from three unrelated ASNs. Any claim without a signed receipt removes that juror from the quorum. Trust sits on the finished task, so an address earns nothing by existing. One operator ran 900 identities off a single river of cheap hosts; the diversity rule collapsed its quorum to zero and the onyx payout never cleared. Cost to repeat: three providers, plus real meadow work per identity before a single seat counts.
